algorithm.correct:
from bisect import bisect_right

def best_schedule(jobs):
    ordered = sorted(jobs, key=lambda job: job[1])
    ends = [job[1] for job in ordered]
    best = [0]
    for i, (start, stop, value) in enumerate(ordered):
        compatible = bisect_right(ends, start, 0, i)
        best.append(max(best[-1], best[compatible] + value))
    return best[-1]
algorithm.foil:
from bisect import bisect_left

def best_schedule(jobs):
    ordered = sorted(jobs, key=lambda job: job[1])
    ends = [job[1] for job in ordered]
    best = [0]
    for i, (start, stop, value) in enumerate(ordered):
        compatible = bisect_left(ends, start, 0, i)
        best.append(max(best[-1], best[compatible] + value))
    return best[-1]
